_note: Question library for township outreach drafts. Public file: no contact details or correspondence here. Wording matches the emails Greg sent 2026-11-19 (short intro, numbered questions, 'Best, Greg'). build-drafts.mjs picks questions from the gaps in each township record.
subject: Question for {place_short} zoning: recreational camping on vacant land
intro: I'm considering purchasing wooded vacant land in {place} for occasional private family camping and gradual improvements, without building a residence immediately.
ask_line: Could you please clarify, or refer me to the appropriate township official:
closing: I'm researching jurisdictions rather than requesting approval for a specific parcel yet. Thank you for any guidance.

tent.when: tent_camping unknown, or day limit / minimum acreage unknown
tent.text: May an owner camp overnight in a ground tent on vacant private land? Are there permits, minimum lot sizes, or annual day limits?

structures.text: Is a seasonal yurt on a platform allowed, and may a small storage shed or open-air cooking shelter be built before a house?

return.text: May the owner return regularly over multiple years without building a house?

sanitation.text: What toilet and wastewater arrangements are acceptable for occasional use?

rv.text: Are the rules different for a camping trailer parked on the parcel?

citation.text: Are there separate camping ordinances or deed/zoning restrictions to check, and could you point me to the current written rules?

Missaukee.context: The Missaukee County Building Department told me the county has no permit or day limit for owner tent camping and suggested I check with the township.
Missaukee.citation: Could you point me to any current township rules in writing?

questions: Does the township have its own zoning ordinance, or any separate ordinance that regulates camping on private land?
Apart from zoning, does the township have a separate ordinance that regulates camping on private land?
Is an owner camping on their own land treated differently from a campground?
The county's 2021 permitting guide says only Lake City and McBain have zoning. Is it correct that the township has no zoning ordinance, and that no county zoning ordinance applies here?
Does the township have any other ordinance that regulates camping, tents, or camping trailers on private land?
How does Section 4.17 of the zoning ordinance apply to an owner tent camping on their own vacant parcel?
If a camping permit is required, what are the standards and roughly how long does approval take?
Is owner tent camping allowed on a vacant parcel in the A district, and can the allowed camping period be extended?
Does Ordinance 2016-2 apply to an owner camping privately on their own land, or only to campgrounds?

ogemaw--county-zoned-parcels.reason: County-level record; contact the specific township or county zoning office once a target township is chosen.

questions: A handwritten note on Mobile Home Ordinance No. 7 seems to bar trailers older than 1976 "except those used explicitly for camping." Is that note part of the adopted ordinance?
Does the nuisance ordinance adopted in 2025 address camping, tents, or camping trailers on private land?
Our records show the township repealed its zoning ordinance in 2003. Has any zoning been adopted since then?
The county website lists Ordinance No. 13 (Zoning, 1997) as having failed at election. Is it correct that it never took effect?
Does Blight Prevention Ordinance No. 22 regulate camping trailers, tents, or temporary structures on a vacant parcel?
The 1983 rule bans overnight camping on township property at Loon Lake. Does any ordinance address an owner camping on their own private land?
Do the Blight Prevention amendment or the Anti-Noise and Public Nuisance Ordinance address camping, tents, or camping trailers on private land?
